meta.title: Literature Infographic — Semiotics, Narrative, Data Comics & Visual Thinking
meta.summary: Buildable visual map of Eric Alvarado's literature—hub network, timeline, reading path, Data Comics gaps, and a filterable catalog updated weekly.
meta.updatedNote: Living map — updated weekly. New verified papers append to works.json (by area and year). Only verified DOI/Open Library/publisher links ship.
meta.verification: Crossref / OpenAlex / Open Library / publisher / DOI (Nov 2026). Unverified works omitted. Blind-spot diamonds are research questions, not additional papers.

blindSpots.title: Sequential-art cognition
blindSpots.why: Underuse of Cohn VLT; operationalize panel roles/layout.

blindSpots.title: Long-term recall & interpretation
blindSpots.why: Wang 2019 + Fogwill 2024 leave longer delays and richer measures open.

blindSpots.title: Comics accessibility
blindSpots.why: Efficacy studies assume sighted panel reading.

blindSpots.title: Isotype & journalism
blindSpots.why: Easy to skip via CHI/TVCG-only entry.

openQuestions.text: Beyond Wang 2019 (1–4 wks) and Fogwill 2024: longer delays and persistence remain open.
Literacy, comics fluency, expertise, cultural visual languages rarely crossed with data-comics stimuli.
Framing, causality, affect—not only factual quizzes.
Manipulate Cohn categories/layout vs monolithic comic format.
Almost no efficacy papers evaluate non-visual reading paths.

works.title: Course in General Linguistics (Cours de linguistique générale)
works.why: Foundational account of the linguistic sign (signifier/signified) that later visual semiotics remediates.

works.title: Collected Papers of Charles Sanders Peirce
works.why: Triadic sign model (icon/index/symbol) widely used in visualization and HCI semiotics.

works.title: Elements of Semiology (Éléments de sémiologie)
works.why: Systematizes denotation/connotation and the semiotic study of cultural objects.

works.title: Rhetoric of the Image (in Image–Music–Text)
works.why: Classic analysis of how images persuade via linguistic and iconic messages.

works.title: A Theory of Semiotics
works.why: Comprehensive theory of codes, signification, and interpretation.

works.title: Reading Images: The Grammar of Visual Design
works.why: Social-semiotic grammar of visual composition; a bridge from linguistics to image analysis.

works.title: Intersemiotic Texture: Analyzing Cohesive Devices between Language and Images
works.why: Analyzes how text and image cohere—useful for multimodal data stories.

works.title: Multimodal Content Analysis: Expanding Analytical Approaches to Content Analysis
works.why: Recent methods paper for analyzing multimodal visual–verbal content.

works.title: Narrative Discourse: An Essay in Method
works.why: Narratology classic: order, duration, frequency, mood, voice.

works.title: Narratology: Introduction to the Theory of Narrative
works.venue: University of Toronto Press / Open Library
works.why: Accessible synthesis of fabula/story/text distinctions for cross-media narrative.

works.title: Story Logic: Problems and Possibilities of Narrative
works.venue: University of Nebraska Press / Open Library
works.why: Cognitive narratology: how stories cue storyworld construction.

works.title: Basic Elements of Narrative
works.why: Compact introduction to situatedness, event sequencing, worldmaking, and what-it's-like.

works.title: Possible Worlds, Artificial Intelligence, and Narrative Theory
works.why: Possible-worlds approach to fictionality and narrative—useful for interactive data stories.

works.title: Possible Worlds Theory and Contemporary Narratology
works.why: Updates possible-worlds narratology for digital/media contexts.

works.title: Metaphors We Live By
works.why: Conceptual metaphor theory underpinning visual metaphor and data storytelling rhetoric.

works.title: Sémiologie graphique (Semiology of Graphics)
works.venue: Open Library (French original); English: Esri Press 2010
works.why: Foundational visual variables and graphic semiology for maps, networks, diagrams. English: https://www.esri.com/en-us/esri-press/browse/semiology-of-graphics-diagrams-networks-maps

works.title: The Visual Display of Quantitative Information
works.why: Canonical design principles (data-ink, chartjunk, integrity) for statistical graphics.

works.title: Graphical Perception: Theory, Experimentation, and Application to the Development of Graphical Methods
works.venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association
works.why: Empirical ranking of visual encodings by perceptual accuracy.

works.title: Automating the Design of Graphical Presentations of Relational Information
works.why: Expressiveness/effectiveness criteria for automated visualization design.

works.title: The Grammar of Graphics
works.why: Layered grammar that later informs ggplot2, Vega, etc.

works.title: Visualization Analysis and Design
works.why: Modern textbook framework: what/why/how, marks & channels, validation.

works.title: Information Visualization: Perception for Design
works.why: Perception science applied to visualization design.

works.title: Crowdsourcing Graphical Perception: Using Mechanical Turk to Assess Visualization Design
works.why: Replicates/extends Cleveland–McGill with crowdsourcing methods.

works.title: Narrative Visualization: Telling Stories with Data
works.why: Defines genres of narrative viz (martini glass, interactive slideshow, etc.).

works.title: Visualization Rhetoric: Framing Effects in Narrative Visualization
works.why: Maps rhetorical techniques and framing effects in data stories.

works.title: Storytelling: The Next Step for Visualization
works.why: Argues for storytelling as a research and practice agenda in viz.

works.title: What Makes a Visualization Memorable?
works.why: Empirically links visual distinctiveness to memorability (with caveats for clutter).

works.title: Beyond Memorability: Visualization Recognition and Recall
works.why: Separates recognition from content recall; titles and annotations matter.

works.title: How Deceptive are Deceptive Visualizations?
works.why: Empirical evidence on how common distortion techniques mislead.

works.authors: Sean McKenna; Nathalie Henry Riche; Bongshin Lee; Jeremy Boy; Miriah Meyer
works.title: Visual Narrative Flow: Exploring Factors Shaping Data Visualization Story Reading Experiences
works.why: Factors shaping reading experience in visualization stories.

works.authors: Ha-Kyung Kong; Zhicheng Liu; Karrie Karahalios
works.title: Frames and Slants in Titles of Visualizations on Controversial Topics
works.why: Shows how title framing shapes perceived message of the same chart.

works.authors: Ha-Kyung Kong; Zhicheng Liu; Karrie Karahalios
works.title: Trust and Recall of Information across Varying Degrees of Title-Visualization Misalignment
works.why: Recall often aligns with title slant even under misalignment; neutrality bias.

works.title: Why Authors Don't Visualize Uncertainty
works.why: Documents barriers to uncertainty visualization—relevant to rhetorical omission.

works.title: Graphesis: Visual Forms of Knowledge Production
works.why: Humanistic critique of graphical knowledge forms.

works.title: Data Feminism
works.why: Power, equity, and situated knowledge as design principles for data work.

works.authors: Helen Kennedy; Rosemary Lucy Hill; Giorgia Aiello; William Allen
works.title: The Work that Visualisation Conventions Do
works.why: Shows how viz conventions naturalize particular social meanings.

works.title: The Feeling of Numbers: Emotions in Everyday Engagements with Data and Their Visualisation
works.why: Centers affect/emotion in everyday data engagements.

works.title: Data Visualization in Society
works.why: Edited volume on social meanings and uses of visualization.

works.title: The Stories We Tell About Data: Surveying Data-Driven Storytelling Using Visualization
works.why: Media-type taxonomy for data-driven storytelling, including comics.

works.authors: Yi He; Ke Xu; Shixiong Cao; Yang Shi; Qing Chen; Nan Cao
works.title: Leveraging Foundation Models for Crafting Narrative Visualization: A Survey
works.why: Survey of LLM/foundation-model approaches to narrative visualization.

works.title: ID.8: Co-Creating Visual Stories with Generative AI
works.why: System/study of co-creating visual stories with generative AI.

works.authors: Verena Ingrid Prantl; Torsten Möller; Laura Koesten
works.title: Untangling Rhetoric, Pathos, and Aesthetics in Data Visualization
works.why: Recent work disentangling rhetorical, emotional, and aesthetic dimensions of viz.

works.authors: Benjamin Bach; Nathalie Henry Riche; Sheelagh Carpendale; Hanspeter Pfister
works.title: The Emerging Genre of Data Comics
works.why: Defines data comics as a genre combining sequential narrative and visualization.

works.authors: Benjamin Bach; Zezhong Wang; Matteo Farinella; Dave Murray-Rust; Nathalie Henry Riche
works.title: Design Patterns for Data Comics
works.why: Catalog of reusable narrative/layout patterns for data comics.

works.authors: Zezhong Wang; Shunming Wang; Matteo Farinella; Dave Murray-Rust; Nathalie Henry Riche; Benjamin Bach
works.title: Comparing Effectiveness and Engagement of Data Comics and Infographics
works.why: Key empirical comparison: comics improved understanding/engagement vs infographics and illustrated text; delayed recall still favored comics on average.

works.authors: Zezhong Wang; Harvey Dingwall; Benjamin Bach
works.title: Teaching Data Visualization and Storytelling with Data Comic Workshops
works.why: Workshop method for teaching viz storytelling via comics.

works.authors: Nam Wook Kim; Nathalie Henry Riche; Benjamin Bach; Guanpeng Xu; Matthew Brehmer; Ken Hinckley et al.
works.title: DataToon: Drawing Dynamic Network Comics with Pen + Touch Interaction
works.why: Authoring tool for dynamic network data comics.

works.authors: Zezhong Wang; Lovisa Sundin; Dave Murray-Rust; Benjamin Bach
works.title: Cheat Sheets for Data Visualization Techniques
works.why: Comic-style cheat sheets supporting learning of viz techniques.

works.authors: Zezhong Wang; Jacob Ritchie; Jingtao Zhou; Fanny Chevalier; Benjamin Bach
works.title: Data Comics for Reporting Controlled User Studies in Human-Computer Interaction
works.why: Applies data comics to scientific reporting of HCI studies.

works.authors: Zezhong Wang; Hugo Romat; Fanny Chevalier; Nathalie Henry Riche; Dave Murray-Rust; Benjamin Bach
works.title: Interactive Data Comics
works.why: Design space and COMICSCRIPT for branching/interactive data comics.

works.title: Interactive Data Comics for Communicating Medical Data to the General Public: A Study of Engagement and Ease of Understanding
works.why: Between-group study (n=98): medical data comics more engaging and better recalled/understood than text.

works.title: Understanding Comics: The Invisible Art
works.why: Seminal practitioner theory of comics: closure, panel transitions, temporal mapping.

works.title: The Visual Language of Comics: Introduction to the Structure and Cognition of Sequential Images
works.why: Visual Language Theory: lexicon + narrative grammar for sequential images.

works.title: Visual Narrative Structure
works.why: Formal narrative grammar for sequential images (Establisher/Initial/Peak/Release).

works.authors: Neil Cohn; Ray Jackendoff; Phillip J. Holcomb; Gina R. Kuperberg
works.title: The Grammar of Visual Narrative: Neural Evidence for Constituent Structure in Sequential Image Comprehension
works.why: ERP evidence that disrupted narrative constituents elicit language-like neural responses.

works.title: The Architecture of Visual Narrative Comprehension: The Interaction of Narrative Structure and Page Layout in Understanding Comics
works.why: How narrative grammar interacts with external compositional structure (layout).

works.title: In Defense of a "Grammar" in the Visual Language of Comics
works.why: Defends Visual Language Theory against discourse-only critiques; reviews empirical standards.

works.title: Visual Thinking
works.venue: University of California Press / Open Library
works.why: Argues perception itself is cognitive—foundational for visual thinking research.

works.authors: Jill H. Larkin; Herbert A. Simon
works.title: Why a Diagram Is (Sometimes) Worth Ten Thousand Words
works.why: Computational account of when diagrams reduce search vs sentential reps.

works.title: External Cognition: How Do Graphical Representations Work?
works.why: External cognition framework for graphical representations in HCI.

works.title: Visualizing Thought
works.why: Principles of how spatial marks and layouts express thought.

works.authors: Barbara Tversky; Sol Kugelmass; Atalia Winter
works.title: Cross-cultural and Developmental Trends in Graphic Productions
works.why: Cross-cultural regularities/differences in graphic production—blind-spot relevant.

works.authors: Barbara Tversky; Jeff Zacks; Paul Lee; Julie Heiser
works.title: Lines, Blobs, Crosses and Arrows: Diagrammatic Communication with Schematic Figures
works.why: How schematic marks carry meaning in diagrams.

works.title: The Language of Graphics: A Framework for the Analysis of Syntax and Meaning in Maps, Charts and Diagrams
works.why: Syntax/semantics framework for graphics as a visual language.

works.title: The Psychology of Everyday Things (later: The Design of Everyday Things)
works.why: Affordances, signifiers, feedback—semiotic engineering for everyday interaction.

works.title: The Semiotic Engineering of Human-Computer Interaction
works.why: HCI as designer–user metacommunication through the interface.

works.title: International Picture Language: The First Rules of Isotype
works.why: Historical root of pictographic statistical communication (Isotype).

works.authors: Jeremy Boy; Ronald A. Rensink; Enrico Bertini; Jean-Daniel Fekete
works.title: A Principled Way of Assessing Visualization Literacy
works.why: Early principled assessment of visualization literacy.

works.authors: Basak Alper; Nathalie Henry Riche; Fanny Chevalier; Jeremy Boy; Metin Sezgin
works.title: Visualization Literacy at Elementary School
works.why: Children's viz literacy and teaching materials.

works.authors: Elif E. Firat; Alark Joshi; Robert S. Laramee
works.title: Interactive Visualization Literacy: The State-of-the-Art
works.why: Survey of interactive visualization literacy research.

works.authors: Carolina Nobre; Kehang Zhu; Eric Mörth; Hanspeter Pfister; Johanna Beyer
works.title: Reading Between the Pixels: Investigating the Barriers to Visualization Literacy
works.why: Classifies translation/encoding/decoding barriers beyond test scores.

works.title: What University Students Learn in Visualization Classes
works.why: Qualitative gains in design empathy/deconstruction vs standardized VL tests.

works.authors: Frank Elavsky; Cynthia Bennett; Dominik Moritz
works.title: How Accessible Is My Visualization? Evaluating Visualization Accessibility with Chartability
works.why: Heuristic audit method for visualization accessibility.

works.authors: Jonathan Zong; Crystal Lee; Alan Lundgard; JiWoong Jang; Daniel Hajas; Arvind Satyanarayan
works.title: Rich Screen Reader Experiences for Accessible Data Visualization
works.why: Designs richer SR experiences beyond alt text.

works.authors: Ather Sharif; Olivia H. Wang; Alida T. Muongchan; Katharina Reinecke; Jacob O. Wobbrock
works.title: VoxLens: Making Online Data Visualizations Accessible with an Interactive JavaScript Plug-In
works.why: Interactive accessible viz plugin (summary, sonification, voice).

works.authors: John R. Thompson; Jesse J. Martinez; Alper Sarikaya; Edward Cutrell; Bongshin Lee
works.title: Chart Reader: Accessible Visualization Experiences Designed with Screen Reader Users
works.why: Co-designed accessible visualization experiences with SR users.

works.authors: Ather Sharif; Sanjana Shivani Chintalapati; Jacob O. Wobbrock; Katharina Reinecke
works.title: Understanding Screen-Reader Users' Experiences with Online Data Visualizations
works.why: Documents accuracy/time gaps for SR users extracting viz information.
